response.sql: WITH invoiced_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM Orders o INNER JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id), customer_invoiced_order_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(io.order_id) as invoiced_order_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN invoiced_orders io ON c.customer_id = io.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), gender_averages AS (SELECT gender, AVG(invoiced_order_count) as avg_per_gender FROM customer_invoiced_order_counts GROUP BY gender), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_gender) as overall_average FROM gender_averages) SELECT ga.gender, ga.avg_per_gender, ga.avg_per_gender - oa.overall_average as exceeds_average FROM gender_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ga.avg_per_gender > oa.overall_average
